name: Tatva
description: AI Powered QR-based Product Verification System.
longDescription: Tatva is a cutting-edge, anti-counterfeiting platform designed to combat product falsification. It leverages FastAPI backends, dynamic QR codes, and AI-enabled metadata analysis to provide instant, decentralized verification of luxury goods and industrial products.
features: Secure unique cryptographic QR code generator and tracker
AI-driven anomaly detection to identify counterfeit patterns based on scan telemetry
High-speed FastAPI router with automatic Swagger generation
Modern dashboard displaying scan analytics, geographic maps of scanning events, and alerts
Fully responsive React user interface featuring glassmorphism elements
problemStatement: Global counterfeiting costs product-based businesses billions annually. Standard QR codes can be easily copied and cloned, leaving consumers unable to verify if a physical purchase is genuinely authentic.
architecture: A decentralized service architecture. Built with React for the interactive client portal. Secure backend handles FastAPI endpoints. A PostgreSQL instance maintains metadata, while an AI modeling layer analyses geolocation, IP addresses, and rate metrics of scanned QR codes to flag fraudulent cloning.
challenges: Developing a cryptographic signature system for QR codes that is highly compact yet completely tamper-proof, alongside handling bursts of concurrent validation traffic.
learningOutcomes: Learned how to integrate AI classification models with live HTTP handlers in Python, and optimize Postgres tables using indexed UUID keys.
futureScope: Adding Hyperledger Fabric blockchain integration to record product manufacturing ledger trails transparently.

name: VerbaFlow
longDescription: VerbaFlow is a multi-threaded desktop utility that provides instant, high-fidelity translation coupled with rich text-to-speech rendering. Engineered with Python, Tkinter, and external translation adapters, it provides a seamless user experience with sub-second latencies.
features: Advanced multi-threaded request pool preventing UI freeze during long api calls
Accurate multilingual translations using state-of-the-art Translation APIs
High-fidelity TTS voices with variable speed controls
Minimalist and aesthetic modern dark-mode GUI custom-styled in Tkinter
Local translation caching to reduce outbound API token consumption
problemStatement: Standard desktop translation programs suffer from poor rendering, frozen UI windows during remote server API calls, and lack accessible text-to-speech features for language learners.
architecture: Python-based desktop structure utilizing CustomTkinter for the modern GUI. A backend engine handles multi-threaded HTTP requests to state-of-the-art translation and synthesis endpoints synchronously without halting the main thread's event loop.
challenges: Synchronizing background worker threads with Tkinter's single-threaded UI drawing loop safely without throwing race condition exceptions.
learningOutcomes: Gained an in-depth understanding of multithreading in Python, handling raw audio streaming formats, and writing custom Tkinter event bindings.
futureScope: Deploying cross-platform installers and adding local, offline translation models (like llama.cpp) to execute without network connections.

name: Detecto
longDescription: Developed an NLP-based crime statement analysis system that detects sentiment and behavioral intent from victim, witness, and suspect statements using transformer-based AI models.
features: Classifies crime statements into Positive, Neutral, and Negative sentiments using the RoBERTa transformer model.
Identifies behavioral patterns such as Denial, Admission, and Defensive responses from textual statements.
Generates Word Clouds, Pie Charts, and performance metrics for intuitive analysis of crime-related data.
Produces structured CSV reports and evaluates model performance using Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, and Confusion Matrix.
problemStatement: Automated the analysis of crime-related statements by identifying sentiment and behavioral patterns, reducing manual effort and improving consistency in forensic text interpretation.
architecture: Dataset → Data Preprocessing → RoBERTa Sentiment Analysis → Behavior Classification → Visualization & Performance Evaluation → Final Report.
challenges: Built a realistic dataset, handled contextual language ambiguity, integrated transformer-based sentiment analysis with rule-based behavioral classification, and evaluated performance on limited labeled data.
learningOutcomes: Gained hands-on experience with NLP, transformer models, text classification, data visualization, model evaluation, and end-to-end machine learning pipeline development.
futureScope: Can be extended for forensic investigations, legal document analysis, psychological behavior assessment, courtroom decision support, and AI-powered criminal intelligence systems.

name: Finder
longDescription: Developed an AI-powered retail analytics platform that transforms CCTV footage into actionable business intelligence using computer vision, customer tracking, event-driven analytics, and interactive dashboards for operational decision-making.
features: Real-Time Customer Detection using YOLOv8 for accurate visitor identification.
Multi-Object Tracking to maintain continuous customer sessions across frames.
Zone-Based Analytics for visitor movement, dwell time, and occupancy insights.
Interactive Dashboard displaying KPIs, heatmaps, conversion rates, and operational metrics.
problemStatement: Traditional CCTV systems focus only on surveillance, leaving valuable customer behavior, store performance, and operational insights hidden. This project converts surveillance footage into measurable retail business intelligence.
architecture: CCTV Footage → YOLOv8 Detection → Multi-Object Tracking → Re-Identification → Zone Intelligence → Event Generation → FastAPI Backend → SQLite Database → Analytics Engine → Streamlit Dashboard
challenges: Handled real-time object detection, customer re-identification, event generation, multi-zone tracking, and scalable analytics while maintaining accurate visitor tracking and reliable retail performance measurements.
learningOutcomes: Strengthened skills in computer vision, FastAPI development, event-driven architecture, dashboard visualization, multi-object tracking, and designing scalable AI-powered retail analytics systems.
futureScope: Extend the platform with cross-camera tracking, predictive analytics, cloud deployment, multi-store comparison, Gemini-powered business insights, and enterprise-scale retail intelligence for large retail chains.
